description: A label used for identifying goods for logistics purposes, such as a barcode, a radio frequency tag or a Vehicle Identification Number (VIN).

identifier.description: The unique identifier of this logistics label.

includedSection.description: A section included in this logistics label.

layoutTypeCode.description: The code specifying the layout type of this logistics label.

markingIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not there is a marking on this logistics label.

seriesEndId.description: The unique identifier of the end of a series of logistics labels.

seriesStartId.description: The unique identifier of the start of a series of logistics labels.

sizeCode.description: The code specifying the size of this logistics label.
